# dtcloud_flavors (Data Source)

Lists the compute flavors available for virtual machines.

Use it so a configuration names a size instead of pasting an id. Flavors are defined by the platform
operator, so there is no resource for them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dtcloud_flavors" "all" {}

# The endpoint takes no filters, so `name` is applied by the provider.
data "dtcloud_flavors" "small" {
  name = "s1.small"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Only return flavors whose name matches exactly. Applied here, not by the API — the endpoint takes no filters, so the full list is fetched either way.

### Read-Only

- `flavors` (List of Object) The flavors that matched. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--flavors))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--flavors"></a>
### Nested Schema for `flavors`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `ram` (String)
- `vcpus` (Number)

## Behaviour worth knowing

* **`name` is applied by the provider.** It matches the whole name, ignoring case. The endpoint takes
  no filters, so the full list is fetched either way.
